question: Will the 12-month change in U.S. average hourly earnings of all private employees (BLS, seasonally adjusted; computed from the level) for February 2025 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2025-02-14) be above 4.08%, its value for December 2024?

rule.threshold_basis: the latest reading as of 2025-01-15 (December 2024), rounded as shown

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
